text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the shopping
district one
afternoon with Yaeno
Muteki...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The food is supposedly excellent,
but it's the
size of the portions that gets
the most attention.
That, and I hear they
have an unusual system...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Incredible—the Grand Portion Placement
Test! It
looks like you're given a rank
based on how much
you manage to eat!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I see. So if I consume this amount, I'll be
rank
ten... There's even a certification to
become a
grand master.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It's a truly incredible amount of food,
but the
thought of being recognized has
my body tingling
with excitement.
Would you mind if I try my hand
at it?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Of course, you're right. Meals are not
meant to
be a measure of strength.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm intrigued by the ranking system,
but... right,
I'll show restraint!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I successfully prevent Yaeno
Muteki from
overeating.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Osu! No matter the endeavor, there are
certain
things that will only avail
themselves to you upon
mastery.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In an effort to open new doors, I shall
take on this
challenge!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Soon afterwards, Yaeno Muteki breaks
through
the limits of her stomach and is
successfully
certified as a "master
gourmet."
